verdict.rationale: Cal.com ships automations (workflows, webhooks, Zapier), so versioning, reviewing and rolling back those automations is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the pack documents version history, change review, or rollback for workflows or webhooks. The CLI's mention of 'versioning' refers to API version handling, not automation versions, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
